## basic analysis

### task 1

```{r}
data(Carseats)
head(Carseats)
?Carseats
```

### task 2

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Base R

```{r}
set.seed(123)
n <- nrow(Carseats)
train_idx <- sample(1:n, size = 0.7 * n)
train <- Carseats[train_idx, ]
test <- Carseats[-train_idx, ]
model_base <- lm(Sales ~ Price + Urban, data = train)
```

#### Tidymodels

```{r}
set.seed(123)
data_split <- initial_split(Carseats, prop = 0.7)
train_tidy <- training(data_split)
test_tidy <- testing(data_split)

model_spec <- linear_reg() %>% 
  set_engine("lm")

recipe_model <- recipe(Sales ~ Price + Urban, data = train_tidy)

workflow_model <- workflow() %>% 
  add_model(model_spec) %>% 
  add_recipe(recipe_model)

fit_tidy <- workflow_model %>% 
  fit(data = train_tidy)
```

:::

### task 3

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Base R

```{r}
summary(model_base)
```

#### Tidymodels

```{r}
tidy(fit_tidy)
glance(fit_tidy)
```

:::

### task 4

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Base R

```{r}
model_full_base <- lm(Sales ~ ., data = train)
summary(model_full_base)
```

#### Tidymodels

```{r}
recipe_full <- recipe(Sales ~ ., data = train_tidy)
workflow_full <- workflow_model %>% 
  update_recipe(recipe_full)

fit_full_tidy <- workflow_full %>% 
  fit(data = train_tidy)

fit_full_tidy %>% tidy()
```

:::

### task 5

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Base R

```{r}
rsq <- c()
adj_rsq <- c()
models <- list()
current <- model_full_base
max_steps <- 5
step <- 0

while(TRUE) {
  if (step >= max_steps) break
  coefs <- summary(current)$coefficients
  if (nrow(coefs) <= 2) break
  pvals <- coefs[-1, 4]
  if (all(pvals < 0.05)) break
  worst <- names(which.max(pvals))
  f <- formula(current)
  predictors <- setdiff(all.vars(f)[-1], worst)
  if (length(predictors) == 0) break
  f <- as.formula(paste("Sales ~", paste(predictors, collapse = "+")))
  current <- lm(f, data = train)
  models <- c(models, list(current))
  rsq <- c(rsq, summary(current)$r.squared)
  adj_rsq <- c(adj_rsq, summary(current)$adj.r.squared)
  step <- step + 1
}
plot(rsq, type = "b", ylim = c(min(adj_rsq), max(rsq)), ylab = "R-squared", xlab = "Step")
lines(adj_rsq, type = "b", col = "red")
```

#### Tidymodels

```{r}
# Skipped for tidy because tidymodels doesn't support manual backward selection easily
```

### task 6

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Base R

```{r}
pred_full <- predict(model_full_base, newdata = test)
rmse_full <- sqrt(mean((test$Sales - pred_full)^2))
rmse_reduced <- sqrt(mean((test$Sales - predict(current, newdata = test))^2))
rmse_full
rmse_reduced
```

#### Tidymodels

```{r}
predict(fit_full_tidy, test_tidy) %>%
  bind_cols(test_tidy) %>%
  metrics(truth = Sales, estimate = .pred) %>%
  filter(.metric == "rmse")
```

### task 8

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Base R

```{r}
train_std <- train
num_vars <- sapply(train_std, is.numeric)
train_std[num_vars] <- scale(train_std[num_vars])
model_std <- lm(Sales ~ ., data = train_std)
summary(model_std)
```

#### Tidymodels

```{r}
recipe_norm <- recipe(Sales ~ ., data = train_tidy) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

workflow_norm <- workflow_model %>% 
  update_recipe(recipe_norm)

fit_norm <- workflow_norm %>% fit(data = train_tidy)

tidy(fit_norm)
```

:::

### task 9

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Base R

```{r}
plot(model_full_base, which = 1:2)
```

#### Tidymodels

```{r}
lm_model <- extract_fit_parsnip(fit_full_tidy)

augmented <- test_tidy %>%
  mutate(.fitted = predict(lm_model, new_data = test_tidy)$.pred,
         .resid = Sales - .fitted)

ggplot(augmented, aes(.fitted, .resid)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Residuals vs Fitted", x = "Fitted", y = "Residuals") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(augmented, aes(sample = .resid)) +
  stat_qq() + stat_qq_line() +
  labs(title = "QQ Plot of Residuals") +
  theme_minimal()
```

:::

## cross-validation and tuning

### task 10

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Base R

```{r}
# base R doesn't directly support CV object creation like tidymodels
```

#### Tidymodels

```{r}
cv_folds <- vfold_cv(train_tidy, v = 5)
```

:::

### task 11–14

```{r}
# Polynomial model tuning
poly_recipe <- recipe(Sales ~ Price, data = train_tidy) %>%
  step_poly(Price, degree = tune())

poly_spec <- linear_reg() %>% set_engine("lm")

poly_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(poly_recipe) %>%
  add_model(poly_spec)

grid <- tibble(degree = 1:5)

tune_res <- tune_grid(poly_wf, resamples = cv_folds, grid = grid, metrics = metric_set(rmse))
collect_metrics(tune_res)

# Finalize polynomial model
best_deg <- select_best(tune_res, metric = "rmse")
final_poly <- finalize_workflow(poly_wf, best_deg)
final_fit <- final_poly %>% fit(data = train_tidy)

predict(final_fit, test_tidy) %>%
  bind_cols(test_tidy) %>%
  metrics(truth = Sales, estimate = .pred)

# KNN tuning
knn_spec <- nearest_neighbor(neighbors = tune()) %>%
  set_engine("kknn") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

knn_recipe <- recipe(Sales ~ Price, data = train_tidy)

knn_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(knn_recipe) %>%
  add_model(knn_spec)

knn_grid <- tibble(neighbors = seq(1, 25, by = 2))

knn_tune <- tune_grid(knn_wf, resamples = cv_folds, grid = knn_grid, metrics = metric_set(rmse))
collect_metrics(knn_tune)

best_knn <- select_best(knn_tune, metric = "rmse")
final_knn <- finalize_workflow(knn_wf, best_knn)
fit_knn <- final_knn %>% fit(data = train_tidy)

predict(fit_knn, test_tidy) %>%
  bind_cols(test_tidy) %>%
  metrics(truth = Sales, estimate = .pred)
```
